text.tspan: Share of girls and boys who are not in upper secondary school
Share of girls and boys of upper secondary school age (typically 15–17 years) not enrolled in upper secondary
education, expressed as a percentage of the total population of girls and boys in that age group.
Data source: UNESCO Institute for Statistics (2026)
